_read_me: Calls scripts/sportegories-people.mjs cannot make on its own. `same`: two names, one man, joined in the game (a nickname, a new surname). `apart`: names the rule finds related, two men. A suffix or a second record under one name needs no line here: the rule joins it. check-sportegories.mjs fails on any related pair that is in neither list.
apart: two infielders who both played for Cleveland and the Yankees
